caption: The yarn club met every single evening; members said they were a very ____ bunch.
scene: Six knitters squeezed shoulder to shoulder on one small sofa, needles clicking, one long scarf joining all their laps.
altText: Six people crowd onto a small sofa working needles on one very long scarf that drapes across all their laps.

caption: The knitting teacher's tip about loose tension turned out to be a real ____.
scene: An elderly knitter leans in to whisper to a wide-eyed beginner, holding up a single perfect stitch like a tiny pearl.
altText: An elderly woman whispers to a young beginner while holding up one stitch on her needle.

caption: The old sailor at the wool shop was famous for ____.
scene: A bearded sailor sits at a spinning wheel in a wool shop, gesturing wildly mid-story as a ball of yarn grows to the size of a beach ball.
altText: A bearded sailor at a wheel tells an animated story while a huge ball of wool grows beside him.

caption: As the ferry's knitting club finished its last row, the captain announced they were ____.
scene: A ferry captain at the wheel calls out as a row of knitters on deck finish their scarves and the mooring rope slips free.
altText: A ferry captain calls out while knitters on deck finish scarves and a mooring rope slips free from the dock.

caption: The knitting circle's daydreamer was, quite literally, ____.
scene: A dreamy knitter stares out of the window with an armful of fleece while sheep queue at the door to hand over more.
altText: A daydreaming knitter holds an armful of fleece as sheep line up at the door with more.

caption: The angler's new rod was no toy; the tackle shop swore it was the ____.
scene: A shopkeeper slaps a fishing reel on the counter with one hand and shakes the angler's hand with the other, both grinning.
altText: A shopkeeper and an angler shake hands over a fishing rod on a counter.

caption: Her first afternoon at the pond and already she was ____.
scene: A girl on a jetty grins at her dangling line while the seat of her dungarees is caught on a giant fishhook hanging from a sign.
altText: A grinning girl fishes from a jetty while the back of her overalls is caught on a large hanging fishhook.

caption: That trout wriggled free right before our angler's net; he admitted it got ____.
scene: A trout leaps out of the water waving goodbye while a stunned angler holds up an empty hook and net.
altText: A trout leaps from the river waving as an angler stares at his empty line and net.

caption: At the bait shop, every new customer got a ____.
scene: A bait-shop owner beams behind the counter as a long earthworm in a tiny bow tie holds the door open for a customer.
altText: A shop owner smiles while a long wriggler in a bow tie holds the door for a customer.

caption: When his line snagged, our angler opened his box of lures, ready to ____.
scene: An angler kneels before an open box bursting with lures, rolling up his sleeves as a hopelessly knotted line trails into the lake.
altText: An angler rolls up his sleeves beside an open box of lures while a tangled line trails into the lake.

caption: When the angler claimed the pike was two metres long, his wife suspected ____.
scene: An angler stretches his arms as wide as they go while his wife raises an eyebrow at the sardine-sized fish in his bucket.
altText: A man stretches his arms wide while a woman looks doubtfully at a tiny catch in his bucket.

caption: She reached the hide before dawn; the club called her its ____.
scene: A birdwatcher in a woolly hat sips from a flask in a dark hide while a robin beside her yawns and checks a tiny wristwatch.
altText: A woman with binoculars sits in a dark hide before sunrise while a robin beside her yawns.

caption: From the top of the tower, the club finally got a ____.
scene: A pigeon in a tiny cap peers through binoculars from a lookout tower while a row of birdwatchers below squint up at it.
altText: A pigeon on a tower looks through binoculars while people below squint upward.

caption: Losing the club quiz over which finch was which left a few ____.
scene: Two birdwatchers stand back to back, arms folded, hair sticking up, while a puffed-up finch between them looks equally huffy.
altText: Two people stand back to back with arms folded while a puffed-up little bird sits between them.

caption: The kingfisher stopped at the hide for barely a second; the club logged it as a ____.
scene: A kingfisher zips past a hide so fast it leaves a blue streak, while a birdwatcher's binoculars spin on their strap.
altText: A kingfisher streaks past a wooden hide while a watcher's binoculars spin on their strap.

caption: The photographer chose her lens without a second thought; it was a ____.
scene: A photographer grabs one lens from a table of twenty with her eyes shut while her assistant covers his face.
altText: A woman with a camera picks a lens from a crowded table with her eyes closed as her assistant winces.

caption: The camera club's weekly meeting was, naturally, a ____.
scene: Eight photographers in a circle all point their lenses at one confused pigeon on a stool in the middle.
altText: Eight people with cameras aim at a pigeon sitting on a stool in the middle of their circle.

caption: The darkroom's grumpiest technician was known throughout the club for his ____.
scene: A scowling technician in a red-lit darkroom pegs up strips of film, each one showing a tiny scowling face.
altText: A frowning man in a red-lit room hangs strips of film that each show a small frowning face.

caption: When the tripod toppled, the camera club's newest member offered to ____.
scene: A beginner rushes forward holding out a long telephoto lens like an outstretched arm while a tripod tips toward the pond.
altText: A young person thrusts a long camera attachment forward to catch a tripod tipping toward a pond.

caption: The chess club sold its spare pieces from a little ____.
scene: A small chess piece in a shopkeeper's apron stands behind a counter selling rows of tiny identical pieces from a shelf.
altText: A small chess piece wearing an apron stands behind a counter beneath a shelf of tiny pieces.

caption: The chess club's security guard only ever worked the ____.
scene: A chess knight in a guard's cap patrols the darkened clubroom with a torch, past rows of sleeping pieces.
altText: A horse-shaped chess piece in a guard's cap patrols a dark room with a torch past sleeping pieces.

caption: The chess grandmaster arrived at the hotel and spent an hour ____.
scene: A grandmaster at a hotel desk signs a chessboard-patterned guest book while the receptionist holds out a key shaped like a king.
altText: A chess player at a hotel desk signs a chequered guest book while the receptionist holds out a key.

caption: The chess club's dance class always began with the same ____.
scene: A row of chess pieces in dance shoes all slide one square forward in perfect unison under a disco ball.
altText: Chess pieces in dance shoes glide forward together under a disco ball.

caption: The chess club's rainy-afternoon sessions became known, unfairly, as the ____.
scene: Two chess players slump over a board with chins in hands while rain streaks the window and the clock has stopped.
altText: Two players droop over a chessboard on a rainy afternoon beneath a stopped clock.

caption: The portrait painter met a film star at the gallery; she called it her ____.
scene: A star-struck painter shakes hands with a glamorous celebrity, accidentally dabbing a blob of paint on the star's sleeve.
altText: A painter shaking hands leaves a smear of paint on a glamorous visitor's sleeve.

caption: The sketch artist at the fair spent the afternoon ____.
scene: A street artist sketches furiously as a huge crowd of onlookers leans in, and her page shows exactly that crowd looking back.
altText: A street artist sketches while onlookers lean in, and her page shows all of them looking back.

caption: As the wobbly stand steadied, the painting teacher murmured, '____.'
scene: A painting teacher tiptoes toward a tottering easel with both hands out while the student behind freezes mid-brushstroke.
altText: An art teacher creeps toward a tottering wooden stand holding a canvas while a student freezes.

caption: After a messy oil class, the painter reached for a ____.
scene: A paint-spattered artist gargles from a glass of water while her rainbow-smeared palette soaks in a sink beside her.
altText: A paint-spattered artist rinses her mouth with water while her paint board soaks in a sink.

caption: The stamp told the envelope how it felt: '____.'
scene: A blushing stamp with a little face clings to the corner of an envelope, which blushes right back.
altText: A stamp with a smiling face clings to the corner of a blushing envelope.

caption: The stamp club's debate over hinges finally reached a ____.
scene: Two stamp collectors argue nose to nose, each with a stamp stuck to the tip of the finger they are jabbing at the other.
altText: Two collectors argue nose to nose, each with a stamp on the tip of a raised finger.

caption: The model railway enthusiast talked about nothing else; he had a ____.
scene: A man with a tiny train circling a loop of rail on top of his head chatters happily while his friend's eyes glaze over.
altText: A man with a tiny toy train circling on his head talks happily while his friend's eyes glaze over.

caption: The model railway builder lost his ____ when the engine derailed.
scene: A hobbyist stares blankly as his model engine tips off the rails, while a little thought-bubble locomotive tumbles out of his head.
altText: A man stares blankly as his model engine tips off its rails and a bubble above his head scatters.

caption: The model railway hobbyist meant to fix the engine but got ____.
scene: A hobbyist wanders off along a branch line of model track, following a tiny signal, while the broken engine waits on the main line.
altText: A man wanders down a branch of miniature rails, leaving a broken toy engine behind on the main line.

caption: When the club's new locomotive was finished, the chairman shouted '____!'
scene: A jubilant club chairman waves a flag as a model engine puffs so hard the whole clubroom fills with cloud.
altText: A club chairman waves a flag while a tiny locomotive fills the room with puffs of white vapour.

caption: After hours in the attic, the model railway builder was ____.
scene: A weary hobbyist slumps beside his layout while his model engine's little puff of smoke droops and fizzles.
altText: A tired man slumps beside a model railway as his toy engine's puff of smoke fizzles out.

caption: The garden club investigated why the carrots leaned and found the ____.
scene: Two gardeners on hands and knees peer into a hole where a knotted carrot root has tied itself to its neighbour.
altText: Two gardeners peer into a hole where a carrot's underground part is knotted around its neighbour.

caption: At the topiary contest, the gardener trimmed two shrubs at once to ____.
scene: A gardener with shears in each hand clips two hedges into a horse and a hare, glancing nervously between them.
altText: A gardener with shears in both hands trims two shrubs, one shaped like a horse and one like a hare.

caption: The garden club's giant pumpkin gave its grower a few ____.
scene: A gardener rubs his aching back while an enormous pumpkin bursts through the roof of his greenhouse.
altText: A gardener rubs his back as a huge pumpkin bursts through the roof of a greenhouse.

caption: The garden club chairman spent the whole meeting ____ bad ideas.
scene: A chairman in gardening gloves yanks paper suggestions out of a flowerbed of ideas, tossing them into a wheelbarrow.
altText: A man in gardening gloves pulls slips of paper from a flowerbed and tosses them into a wheelbarrow.

caption: The choir shared one changing room without a single squabble; they lived in ____.
scene: Twelve choristers in matching robes hum contentedly as they share one mirror, each holding up a hairpin for the next.
altText: Twelve choir singers in robes share one mirror and pass hairpins along the line.

caption: The choir's tallest singer always finished on a ____.
scene: A towering chorister on the back row sings from up near the rafters, a musical note floating even higher above her.
altText: A very tall singer in the back row of a choir reaches almost to the rafters.

caption: The choir mistress begged the quietest alto to please ____.
scene: A tiny alto is hoisted up a stepladder by the choir mistress so her whisper of a note can reach the front row.
altText: A choir leader lifts a small singer up a stepladder toward the rest of the group.

caption: The choir's smallest sopranos caused ____ at every rehearsal.
scene: Three tiny choristers stand on a bench, mouths wide, hitting a note so high the conductor's glasses crack.
altText: Three small singers on a bench sing a note so high the conductor's glasses crack.

caption: The wooden platform trembled before the show; the carpenter blamed ____.
scene: A theatre stage with a nervous face on its front boards shivers on its legs while a carpenter pats it reassuringly.
altText: A wooden theatre platform with a nervous face trembles as a carpenter pats it kindly.

caption: The theatre society's seamstress got a telephone message about the drapes: a ____.
scene: A seamstress with pins in her mouth answers a ringing telephone that is wrapped in yards of red velvet.
altText: A seamstress with pins in her mouth answers a telephone wrapped in red velvet.

caption: The forgetful actor's whispering helper always gave a ____.
scene: A prompter in the wings whispers a line while the actor onstage, frozen mid-gesture, cups an ear toward her.
altText: A helper in the wings whispers to an actor frozen mid-gesture onstage.

caption: Someone kept swiping the painted backdrops; the drama club hunted the ____.
scene: A theatre cat tiptoes offstage dragging a painted forest backdrop while an actor onstage gestures at a bare wall.
altText: A cat drags a painted forest backdrop offstage while an actor points at the bare wall behind him.

caption: At our county fair, a judge's spaniel was caught ____.
scene: A spaniel trots away from the baking table with a prize-winning shortbread in its mouth while the judge stares at her empty plate.
altText: A spaniel trots off with a shortbread in its mouth as a judge stares at an empty plate.

caption: At the pancake contest, the umpire shouted ____.
scene: An umpire in a chef's hat points at a bowl of pancake mix stepping up to home plate with a whisk for a bat.
altText: An umpire in a chef's hat points as a bowl of pancake mix stands at home plate holding a whisk.

caption: The bread judge checked the dough had doubled and declared it ____.
scene: A judge lifts a tea towel from a bowl of dough that has risen into a giant grinning thumbs-up.
altText: A judge lifts a towel from a bowl where the dough has risen into the shape of a thumbs-up.

caption: The jigsaw club's motto was simple: what we cannot fix alone, we ____.
scene: Four puzzlers kneel around a broken teapot, each fitting in a shard as if it were part of a jigsaw.
altText: Four people kneel around a broken teapot, each fitting a shard into place.

caption: When one club member yawned, the whole table followed; it was the ____.
scene: Around a table of dominoes, six players topple sideways one after another, each mid-yawn.
altText: Six players at a game table tip sideways one after another, each yawning.

caption: At the board game club's roundabout, the sign politely read ____.
scene: A sign at a miniature roundabout in a clubroom shows an arrow curving right, while a die on wheels waits obediently.
altText: A die on wheels waits at a miniature roundabout beneath a sign with a curving arrow.

caption: The dance teacher checked the new pupil's shoes and found ____.
scene: A dance teacher kneels to examine a beginner's shoes, both of which curve the same way, while the pupil shrugs.
altText: A dance teacher kneels to examine a beginner's shoes, which are both shaped for the same foot.

caption: Our dance instructor's dog insisted on ____.
scene: A poodle in a bow tie waltzes across the studio floor holding its own leash in its teeth while the instructor is towed along.
altText: A poodle in a bow tie waltzes across a dance studio holding its leash in its teeth, towing the instructor.

caption: Yoga night at the bowling alley always began with everyone ready to ____.
scene: A row of yogis in tree pose stand on a bowling lane while a ball rolls toward them and the pins behind copy the pose.
altText: A row of yoga students balance on one leg on a bowling lane as a ball rolls toward pins copying them.

caption: Before the underwater yoga class, the instructor told everyone to take a ____.
scene: A yoga instructor in goggles puffs out her cheeks like a balloon at the pool edge while her students copy her.
altText: A yoga teacher in goggles puffs out her cheeks at a pool edge while students copy her.

caption: The book club's gardener rotated her vegetable patch; the members called it a ____.
scene: A gardener spins a square vegetable bed like a lazy Susan while book club members gasp behind their novels.
altText: A gardener spins a square vegetable bed like a turntable while readers gasp behind their books.

caption: The library's tiniest member ate its way through the whole reading list; a true ____.
scene: A bespectacled worm pokes out of a neat hole through a stack of novels, dabbing its mouth with a napkin.
altText: A small caterpillar in glasses pokes out of a hole bored through a stack of novels, holding a napkin.

caption: The mountain club's choir sang from the summit, a real ____.
scene: Six hikers in boots and backpacks belt out a song from a snowy summit while an eagle conducts with a twig.
altText: Six hikers sing from a snowy mountaintop as an eagle waves a twig like a conductor.

caption: Getting the club's picnic hamper to the summit was an ____.
scene: Three ramblers heave an enormous wicker hamper up a steep slope while a sandwich escapes and rolls back down.
altText: Three hikers push a huge wicker hamper up a steep slope while a sandwich rolls back down.

caption: The rambling club's farewell to its retiring leader was, naturally, ____.
scene: A retiring hiker waves goodbye from a footpath lined with smiling faces painted on every signpost.
altText: A hiker waves goodbye along a footpath whose signposts each have a smiling face.

caption: The kite maker swore the tail was nearly done; he'd been ____ his customers for months.
scene: A kite maker with a mile of string trailing behind him leads a queue of customers around the park, each holding a bit of it.
altText: A man trails a very long cord through a park while a line of customers each hold a piece of it.

caption: The astronomy club planted its telescopes ten metres apart, nicely ____.
scene: Five stargazers stand at widely separated telescopes across a dark field, each waving to a distant neighbour.
altText: Five stargazers stand far apart at telescopes in a dark field, waving to one another.

caption: The astronomer's second job was, of course, ____.
scene: An astronomer on a stepladder polishes the full moon like a lamp, a feather duster in one hand and a lunchbox at her feet.
altText: An astronomer on a stepladder polishes a huge full moon with a duster, lunchbox at her feet.

caption: The stargazer misplaced his glasses somewhere inside the planetarium; he was ____.
scene: A squinting astronomer gropes across a planetarium floor under a dome of projected stars, glasses perched on his head.
altText: A squinting man gropes across a dark planetarium floor beneath projected stars, glasses on his head.

caption: The magician scored three goals for the village team; the paper called it a ____.
scene: A magician in cape and top hat wheels away in celebration on a football pitch as three rabbits sit in the goal net.
altText: A magician in a cape celebrates on a football pitch while three rabbits sit inside the goal net.

caption: When the magician's audience left for the interval, the critic called it a ____.
scene: A magician bows to a hall of empty seats with only one popcorn box left behind, his rabbit applauding politely.
altText: A magician bows to rows of empty seats while his rabbit claps politely.

caption: The tightrope walker's accountant called the year-end books a ____.
scene: An accountant in a visor tiptoes along a tightrope holding a ledger in each hand while a tightrope walker below checks the sums.
altText: An accountant tiptoes along a high wire holding ledgers while a performer below reviews figures.

caption: The circus manager also ran the bell-ringing club; naturally he was the ____.
scene: A circus manager in a red coat conducts a row of bell-ringers, each hanging from a trapeze rope in the big top.
altText: A man in a red coat conducts bell-ringers who dangle from trapeze ropes under a circus tent.

caption: When triplets joined the acrobat troupe, the manager called rehearsal a ____.
scene: Three identical acrobats each juggle in their own hoop while the exasperated manager spins between them.
altText: A trio of identical acrobats perform in separate hoops while a manager spins between them.

caption: At the village fete, the coconut shy was ____.
scene: A coconut on a stand grins and waves a tiny flag as a child winds up to throw a ball at it.
altText: A grinning coconut on a stand waves a flag as a child prepares to throw a ball.

caption: The museum's portraits spent every night ____.
scene: Framed portraits in a dark gallery lean out of their frames to chat, one dangling its legs over the picture rail.
altText: Framed portraits in a dark gallery lean out of their frames to chat, one dangling its legs.

caption: The library's tallest visitor finally returned his book; it was ____.
scene: A very tall man stoops through the library door holding a tiny book while the librarian consults a calendar covered in cobwebs.
altText: A very tall man stoops through a library doorway holding a small book while the librarian checks a cobwebbed calendar.

caption: The librarian suggested story time at the pool; the lifeguard called it a ____.
scene: A librarian reads aloud from the diving board to a pool full of children floating on inflatable books.
altText: A librarian reads aloud from a diving board to children floating on inflatable books in a pool.

caption: The orchestra's brass section brought all the picnic food; the conductor called it a ____.
scene: A tuba player tips his instrument and out pours a cascade of grapes, bread rolls and apples onto the picnic blanket.
altText: A tuba player tips his instrument and fruit and bread pour out onto a picnic blanket.

caption: The harpist got jittery before every concert; colleagues said she was ____.
scene: A wide-eyed harpist perches on top of a very tall harp, gripping the strings, while the conductor beckons her down.
altText: A nervous harpist perches on top of a very tall harp while the conductor beckons her down.

caption: The gym's laundry volunteer spent all morning ____.
scene: A muscly volunteer in a gym vest hoists a hot iron overhead like a barbell while a mountain of creased shirts waits.
altText: A muscular volunteer lifts a clothes press overhead like a barbell beside a pile of creased shirts.

caption: Asked when he'd manage a heavier bar, the trainer said just ____.
scene: A trainer points at a barbell with a big question mark on each end while a hopeful beginner squints at it.
altText: A trainer points to a barbell marked with question marks while a beginner squints at it.

caption: The gym's apple-loving trainer pinned his ____ to the wall.
scene: A trainer proudly pins a row of apple cores to a noticeboard headed with a little heart, while a member munches thoughtfully.
altText: A trainer pins a row of eaten apple centres to a noticeboard while a gym member munches.
